Genome scan for a single QTL

Source: R/mapping-sim.R
qtl_scan.Rd

Single-marker regression ("marker"), marker-within-family regression as in nested association mapping joint linkage ("family_marker"), or regression on founder-origin dosages ("haplotype", for MAGIC). LOD scores compare the residual sum of squares with and without the locus. The genome-wide threshold is the 1 - alpha quantile of the maximum LOD over n_perm permutations of the phenotypes (within families when there are several).

Usage

qtl_scan(
  markers,
  y,
  family,
  map,
  model = c("marker", "family_marker", "haplotype"),
  n_perm = 100,
  alpha = 0.05,
  threshold = NULL,
  step = NULL,
  origin = NULL
)

Arguments

markers

Marker dosage matrix (markers x lines, coded 0/1/2).

y

Phenotypes.

family

Family of each line.

map

Genetic map from sim_genetic_map().

model

Scan model.

n_perm

Permutations for the threshold.

alpha

Genome-wide type I error rate.

threshold

A fixed LOD threshold instead of permutations.

step

Scan every step cM instead of every marker (NULL for every marker).

origin

Founder origin matrices for the haplotype model.

Value

A list with the scan positions, lod and threshold.

Details

The haplotype model uses the true founder origin of each allele, so it is an upper bound on what haplotype reconstruction (e.g. with qtl2) achieves.
